description: SessionStart is silent without saved work. session-budget auto-loads one pending handoff after /clear or /compact, lists several, and only names them on a new or resumed session; offload lists persistent handoffs without taking ownership and hands a session that owns a ledger its board. On a new session it also adds one line when a dream pass is due (the private review criteria's Last dreamed date is over 14 days old, or five runs changed since), at most once in three days; BORK_DREAM_REMINDER=0 turns that off and nothing runs by itself. Stop refuses once when that ledger still owes the architect a judgment, ruling or owner. Helper paths are resolved by the active skill. UserPromptSubmit fires throttled session-budget nudges, measured in the context tokens of the last turn (transcript bytes only when no usage record is found). skill-usage appends the name of each Skill tool call (PreToolUse) and each slash-typed command (UserPromptSubmit) to ~/.agent-handoffs/usage/skills.jsonl; it never blocks and records no arguments. BORK_SKILL_USAGE_LOG=0 turns it off.
